questions.q: What does the core BPE algorithm do at each iteration during training?
options: Removes the least frequent token from the vocabulary
Merges the single most frequent adjacent pair of symbols into a new vocabulary entry
Randomly samples a new token and adds it to the vocabulary
Splits every word into individual characters permanently
questions.explain: BPE iteratively counts adjacent symbol pairs across the corpus and merges the most frequent pair into a new symbol, repeating until the target vocabulary size is reached.

questions.q: What is the main advantage of byte-level BPE over purely word-level tokenization?
options: It eliminates the need for special tokens entirely
Any input text is always representable, since the base units are raw bytes rather than whole words
It always produces a smaller vocabulary than word-level tokenization
It removes the need for a pre-tokenizer
questions.explain: Because byte-level BPE starts from raw bytes, every possible input sequence can be encoded, avoiding a hard 'unknown word' wall that purely word-level vocabularies hit.

questions.q: In the `tokenizers` library, what role does `trainers.BpeTrainer` play?
options: It trains the final language model's weights
It drives the merge-learning process over a corpus to build a vocabulary of a target size, given parameters like vocab_size and special_tokens
It converts tokenized IDs back into strings
It downloads pretrained model checkpoints from the Hub
questions.explain: BpeTrainer is configured with parameters like vocab_size, min_frequency, and special_tokens, and drives the iterative merge process when you call train or train_from_iterator.

questions.q: Why are special tokens like `<s>`, `</s>`, and `<pad>` passed explicitly to the trainer's `special_tokens` list?
options: So they are excluded from the vocabulary entirely
So they are guaranteed a fixed, reserved token ID and are never merged away during training
So the model can automatically translate between languages
So the tokenizer trains faster on GPUs
questions.explain: Special tokens carry structural meaning (sequence boundaries, padding) rather than linguistic meaning, so they're reserved up front to guarantee a known, stable token ID.

questions.q: What does wrapping a raw `tokenizers.Tokenizer` in a `PreTrainedTokenizerFast` accomplish?
options: It retrains the tokenizer with a different algorithm
It gives the tokenizer the same encode/decode/save_pretrained interface used by every tokenizer on the Hugging Face Hub, so it works directly with transformers
It compresses the vocabulary to a smaller size
It converts the tokenizer into a vision model preprocessor
questions.explain: PreTrainedTokenizerFast wraps the low-level tokenizer object so it exposes the standard transformers tokenizer API, letting it drop directly into an existing training pipeline.
